subQuests.subQuestName: Go to Sangonomiya Shrine and talk to Tsuyuko

400610101.text: A breeze from the south blew across Watatsumi Island today — a sure sign that friends would come visit.

400610102.text: Every time you say something like this, that means things are about to get busy... for us.

400610103.text: Oh, don't say that. Haven't we had a fruitful partnership? The most fruitful sort, in fact.

400610104.text: That said, I do have something to ask of the two of you today.

400610105.text: It is told in my family that apart from the Watatsumi Goryou Matsuri, we also added a different set of trials. One unrelated to Watatsumi Island's survival, but instead, related to the truth.

400610107.text: Now that the island is no longer under existential threat, I would just like to tell you this. Consider it our clan's duty.

400610108.text: You can go to the place they call the Serpent's Heart. The clues to this second set of trials is hidden there.

400610109.text: ...Well, that's a relief! Guess I can safely hand this crushing responsibility on to my future daughter now.

400610110.text: ...Is that how you pay respect to your ancestral mission?

400610111.text: Paimon still doesn't get you even after all this time, Tsuyuko...

subQuests.subQuestName: Investigate the Serpent's Heart during Evernight
Investigate the Serpent's Heart during Evernight

722750101.text: That I have appeared before you must mean that the Bloodbranch Coral is in Watatsumi's hands. And a most comforting thought that is.

722750102.text: My name is Erebos. In the Inazuman tongue, that would be Eboshi. I am an auxiliary of Sangonomiya, one of the shrine maidens of Enkanomiya.

722750103.text: You must be the hero who obtained the coral, I suppose?

722750105.text: My apologies, but that which I shall shortly speak of is a most complicated matter. In truth, I do not know where to begin.

722750106.text: Just start from the start! We'll listen!

722750107.text: You have my gratitude. In that case, allow me to introduce such matters as I may to you. We must begin with Watatsumi Omikami opening the gate to the depths.

722750108.text: The depths of Enkanomiya play host to a natural cave system that leads to Watatsumi Island. This is the paradise that was promised to us by Watatsumi Omikami.

722750109.text: At Omikami's instruction, we learned the culture of Narukami, and we established foreign relations with many different nations.

722750110.text: Narukami Island even knew us as the "beauties of Watatsumi," renowned for our soft skin, which would conceal seven types of skin blemish...

722750111.text: ...This, of course, being mostly a consequence of our ancestors' lack of sunlight in the depths of Enkanomiya...

722750114.text: Ah, sorry. During the process of establishing foreign relations, I would give guided tours to visitors in my role as a Sangonomiya auxiliary, so I just...

722750115.text: Right. Back to the point. Lady Sangonomiya and I had a disagreement, which resulted in the current arrangement, following Watatsumi Omikami's mediation.

722750116.text: Due to the phenomenon known as Sinshades, the "past," "history," and "truth" of Enkanomiya would endure even if left to their own devices.

722750117.text: As such, great effort was expended, not that we might remember, but that we might "forget." Lady Sangonomiya was of this view.

722750118.text: (The Sangonomiya she's talking about must've been from a real long time ago...)

722750119.text: The trial to obtain the branch was intended to limit the number of people coming after us who could know the whole truth of the matter.

722750120.text: As for me, I supported leaving records of the truth. As such, Watatsumi Omikami permitted me to add another trial path that, if passed, would lead to knowledge of our secrets.
